_doc: Where the city scene (game/scenes/city.tscn) starts the player (P1-024). The game arg --spawn=<id> picks one, no arg takes `default`. A pin is a WGS84 point and a compass heading in degrees (0 north, 90 east); the game projects it with the world frame of the tile index, loads the ring there and stands the vehicle on the nearest lane at grade within 60 m whose direction is within 60 degrees of the heading, facing along that lane (game/world/world_stream.gd boot, lanes.gd snap). `vehicle` is the tune the player starts in. A pin whose tile is not in the loaded tile folder (the 9-tile test block has no Janpath) is skipped: the old start on the longest lane of the tile nearest India Gate applies. Points were read from the lane graph of the pilot bake (tools/fixtures/gen_city_routes.mjs starts its routes from the same pins).

cp_auto_stand.name: the auto stand on Janpath, south of Connaught Place

cp_inner_circle.name: the south side of the Connaught Place inner circle (clockwise)

ito_flyover_south.name: the Ring Road south of the ITO flyover, northbound

chandni_chowk_east.name: Netaji Subhash Marg south of the Red Fort end of Chandni Chowk, northbound (P2-045: the main road itself is car-free in the day; the pin stood on it until then)

rajpath_india_gate.name: the road from the south-west into the India Gate hexagon, north-eastbound with India Gate ahead (P2-045: Kartavya Path is a promenade closed to cars; the pin stood on it until then)

chandni_bollards_nsm.name: Netaji Subhash Marg southbound, 120 m short of the Red Fort end of Chandni Chowk (P2-042: the car meets the bollards)

gali_scooter_entry.name: a residential lane north of Chandni Chowk that runs on into a gali (P2-042: the scooter rides in)

gali_car_entry.name: the same lane in a car (P2-045: the car drives into the gali, a violation with no bollards)
